def transform(grid):
    # Replace the final incomplete horizontal run of the dominant marked row color
    # with the complementary half-color, preserving the background.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg]
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    mark = Counter(colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    runs = []
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        xs = [c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == mark]
        if xs:
            runs.append((r,xs))
    if runs:
        r,xs = runs[-1]
        # Complete the segment to the right using the alternate color.
        alt = next((v for v in range(10) if v not in (bg, mark)), 1)
        for c in range(max(xs)+1, len(out[r])):
            out[r][c] = alt
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    g=[[9]*8 for _ in range(10)]; g[4]=[3]*8; g[8]=[3,3,3,3,9,9,9,9]
    assert transform(g)[8] == [3,3,3,3,1,1,1,1]
PY
